title: LCMV Beamformer
text: Narrowband linear constraint minimum variance (LCMV) beamformer, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Constraint matrix} sets the lCMV beamformer constraint matrix complex, {Desired response vector} sets the desired response for LCMV beamforming, {Diagonal loading factor}, {Enable training data input}, {Enable weights output} enables output of beamformer weights and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Input signal M -by- N complex-valued matrix

ports.name: XT
ports.summary: Training signal P -by- N complex-valued matrix

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Beamformed output M -by-1 complex-valued column vector

ports.name: W
ports.summary: Beamformer weights output N -by-1 complex-valued column vector

params.name: Constraint matrix
params.values: LCMV beamformer constraint matrix complex([1;1]) (default) | N -by- K complex-valued matrix

params.name: Desired response vector
params.values: Desired response for LCMV beamforming 1 (default) | real-valued K -by-1 column vector

params.name: Enable training data input
params.values: Enable training data input port off (default) | on

params.name: Enable weights output
params.values: Enable output of beamformer weights off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
